_doc: STATE-SINK-1 (ZHC-R1): staged move of machine state out of git. Each state area of doctrine/repo-shape.json has a stage: git (today), dual (writer writes D1/R2 and git; readers prefer D1/R2), moved (writer stops writing git; files archived under refs/archive, never deleted). One area moves at a time, the canary first; an area advances only when its probe passes (readers and writers named in `statesink --inventory` all handle the stage). Read by foundation/statesink.py.
